events.verdict: Kuzma (LAL) places his arms against Doncic's (DAL) back when he sets the screen but he does not deliver the contact.
Jordan (DAL) briefly engages and disengages with Ingram (LAL) on the screen before diving to the basket.
Ingram (LAL) and Jordan (DAL) engage and disengage during the rebound.
Matthews (DAL) briefly places a hand/arm to the front of James (LAL) during his drive but does not affect his SQBR.
James (LAL) places his off-arm against Doncic (DAL) but does not dislodge him from his legal guarding position.
Doncic (DAL) makes marginal contact with James (LAL) that does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
McGee (LAL) jumps A to B into the body of Doncic (DAL) and affects his driving shot attempt.
McGee (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in Doncic's (DAL) path from a wide stance, but he absorbs the contact to his chest and does not deliver any leg-to-leg contact.
Doncic (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on the jump shot by Ingram (LAL).
Jordan (DAL) makes contact with Ingram's (LAL) arm during his shooting motion that affects the release of his jump shot.
James (LAL) makes marginal contact with Matthews (DAL) off ball.
James (LAL) wraps Jordan (DAL) around the waist prior to him receiving the pass.
Following the screen, Doncic (DAL) briefly places an arm on McGee's (LAL) back but immediately removes it.
Ingram (LAL) slides his pivot foot at the end of his dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] Doncic (DAL) slides his pivot foot after his gather.
Kuzma (LAL) and Jordan (DAL) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Ingram (LAL) briefly places a hand/arm to the side of Doncic (DAL) during his drive, but does not affect his SQBR.
Matthews (DAL) moves A to B into Kuzma (LAL) and initiates the contact to the body during his pass.
Hart (LAL) briefly places a hand/arm to the side of Doncic (DAL) during his drive, but does not affect his SQBR.
Matthews (DAL) makes contact to James' (LAL) arm/shoulder that affects his SQBR as he begins his drive.
